chunks: If you are in doubt of what We have sent down to you, then ask those who have been reading the Book before you. The truth has indeed come to you from your Lord, so do not be one of those who doubt.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about doubt and consulting previous scriptures?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a reassurance to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) rather than an indication of personal doubt, with 'those who read the Book' referring to the Ahl al-Kitab or specifically the Imams who possess the true interpretation of previous scriptures. It underscores the continuity of divine truth across revelations and serves as a practical method for verifying prophethood through the testimony of those well-versed in Torah and Gospel. This highlights the Shia emphasis on the reliability of scriptural evidence and the role of knowledgeable authorities in confirming divine messages.
